A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same noise-sensitivity study. Their text, equations, figures, and complete appendices are readable, including the newly added Appendix B in v2.

before.justification: Section 4 reports original noise simulations on DOTMark images, synthetic examples, and simulated cryo-EM projections.

after.justification: Section 4 retains the original simulation studies and reports updated fitted coefficients and noise-sweep results.

M1.justification: Appendix B introduces an additional signed unbalanced Kantorovich–Rubinstein cost, allowing subcouplings and penalizing unmatched mass through parameter C. This is a limited cost-function extension; the signed Wasserstein procedure used in the experiments remains unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same microscopy images, white-noise images, cryo-EM projections, and sparse square/single-pixel scenarios. Appendix B adds theory without evaluating another dataset or task.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain L2, W1, and W2, with W3 also appearing in Figures 3 and 7. Newly cited flow-matching and partial/unbalanced transport methods are not evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: Section 4.2 changes the reported noise-standard-deviation range from 10^-4–10^-2 to 10^-7–10^-1. Figure 4 separately changes its evaluated sweep from 10^-7–10^-1 to 10^-4–1. These revise settings within retained scenarios without establishing that all experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: Figure 4 revises the existing sensitivity analysis across four image classes, extending the high-noise evidence and showing more of W2's recovery after its dip. The cryo-EM distance-matrix and noise-bridging case studies are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions report 100 independent trials in Section 4.1 and averaging over 100 experiments in Section 4.2 and Figure 6. Neither introduces seed disclosures, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Figure 2 changes fitted coefficients from 20.807 to 20.868 for W1, 0.970 to 0.967 for W2, and 31.971 to 31.978 for L2. Figure 4 reports revised results on its changed noise grid. The principal robustness findings and cryo-EM distance matrices remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Theorems 2–3 extend from a clean image versus its noisy copy to two independently corrupted copies, with adjusted upper-bound constants; Theorem 2 also adds an n*sigma/sqrt(pi) lower bound and proof. New Appendix B defines unbalanced transport quantities and adds Proposition 7, Theorem 6, and their derivations.

C1.justification: The contribution summary removes the 'up to log terms' qualification from the claimed (n*sigma)^(1/p) scaling, aligning it with the existing no-log Theorem 3 bound. The abstract and conclusion otherwise retain the central robustness, decreasing-distance, and cryo-EM geometry claims.

C2.justification: v2 removes v1's specific smoother-loss-landscape and reduced-overfitting explanation for OT-based generative models. Section 4.3 newly interprets the retained cryo-EM demonstration as potentially useful for recovering continuous conformational manifolds. The principal bound-tightness and triangle-inequality limitations remain.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code-repository link, an explicit mean-subtracted Gaussian sampling recipe, and disclosure that cryo-EM images are normalized to unit mass. It removes v1's explicit cryo-EM noise setting of sigma = 0.01. The normalization disclosure does not establish a changed procedure.

R1.justification: Research positioning expands substantially to flow matching and OT-based couplings, partial/unbalanced transport, and conformational manifold recovery. Appendix B connects the analysis to additional unbalanced-transport theory. The earlier Li et al. loss-landscape discussion and citation are removed.

P1.justification: Rewriting concentrates on related work and the cryo-EM section, with additional proof explanations and terminology edits. Appendix A reorganizes existing propositions and proofs and repeats theorem statements alongside proofs; the main section sequence remains.

P2.justification: Figure 2 changes from one overlaid chart to three metric panels; Figures 3 and 7 explicitly label theoretical bounds, Figure 4 changes axes, and several figures move. All eight figures are retained. The new Figure 6 caption incorrectly describes top/bottom panels although its matrices remain in one row.

improvement.justification: The added lower bound, code link, broader context, and clearer legends provide benefits. However, new Appendix B contains unresolved mathematical inconsistencies: Theorem 6's proof assigns positive expected mass imbalance under zero-sum Assumption 1, and Equation 110 does not preserve Equation 109's pth-root scaling. These substantive concerns, together with the Figure 6 caption regression and removed cryo-EM noise parameter, prevent a reliable net quality judgment.
